findings.finding: The interim co-CEO presents 'What Patients Really Want' at the National Telehealth and Virtual Care Summit on Monday 2026-09-28 at 9:15am PT (12:15 ET), in the middle of the scored session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The company dated it 09-28 at 9:15am PT, which falls inside the next session. This issuer puts out a PR every 2-4 days (09-08, 09-15, 09-18, 09-21, 09-25), so a follow-up release around the talk is its habit, but that is not a promise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The same kind of promotional release on 09-21 (new website) came during the fade, which continued: 09-23 -10.4%, 09-24 -8.6%, 09-25 -9.7% intraday. The release announcing this talk landed today and the stock still fell 9.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The announcement is priced. What is not priced is any new content (partner, patient numbers, app metrics) disclosed at the talk. If that were priced, today's fade would have paused on the release, and it did not.
findings.independence: https://www.stocktitan.net/news/MEDS/ lists the same release. That is the same document, not independent support.

outside_window.finding: Resale S-1 filed 2026-08-07 registers 34,462,058 shares (21.3M from note and preferred conversions, 8.3M PIPE warrants, 3.58M placement-agent warrants) against 2.85M outstanding. The May 2026 notes ($20.3M principal) convert at the lesser of $6.00 and the prior close, with a $1.00 floor. There is no S-1/A and no EFFECT notice, so there is no date for when the supply unlocks.

PRE 14C (2026-08-31) takes a majority written consent (50.2%) for Nasdaq 5635(d) approval of unlimited issuance to Silverback Capital under its 2026-01-28 3(a)(10) settlement. There is no DEF 14C yet, and approval is effective 20 days after mailing, so it cannot land before mid-October.

Helomics acquisition note ($1,363,672 at a $1.00 conversion price, about 1.36M shares) converts automatically on stockholder approval. The meeting must be held within 75 days of the 09-11 closing, and the seller is locked up for 12 months.

Going concern: an accumulated deficit of $137.1M, a stockholders' deficit of $19.5M, cash of $2.46M at 2026-06-30, and $6.3M of operating cash burn in six months. The settlement's claimed $19M liability removal will first show in the Q3 10-Q (an estimated November date, not company-announced).
